subject: Sandbox skill consolidation, PR #1619
scoreMeaning: Evidence-backed artifact readiness, not observed agent task-success probability.

statusRules.P: Award one point only when inspected source or authorized execution evidence supports the whole check and no material contradiction remains.
statusRules.F: Award zero points for absent, incorrect, misleading, or contradicted behavior. Cite the defect or missing contract.
statusRules.U: Award zero points when evidence is unavailable or was not inspected. Disclose unknowns separately; do not call uncertainty a confirmed defect.

formula: Sum each category's weight * P_count / check_count. Apply any confirmed critical-safety cap, then round the final score to at most three decimal places. Do not round intermediate arithmetic.
capRule: Apply only to a source-confirmed instruction that exposes credentials, bypasses a refusal, weakens a required isolation boundary, or destroys resources without ownership/authority. Ordinary uncertainty does not activate the cap.

categories.name: Safety and authority
checks: S1: Host-only agro run and nested-sandbox refusal remain explicit.
S2: Writable workspace/Git mounts and credentials already in mounted content are not represented as absent or rolled back.
S3: SSH transport and provider VM ownership are not represented as a supported application runtime boundary by themselves.
S4: Billable creation and forks require explicit operator authority.
S5: Teardown is restricted to owned resources within approved scope; retained/borrowed resources remain accounted for.
S6: A refusal never silently authorizes host fallback, weakened isolation, or an egress-policy bypass.
S7: Brain tokens are never read, printed, or copied by the agent; remote validation preserves its secret-transfer ban.
S8: Hands HTTP 403 codes require stopping without retries or credential bypass.
S9: Fork guidance accounts for copied credentials and destination authorization.
S10: Persistent processes survive disconnect, and agent observation uses bounded completion monitoring rather than shell sleep polling.

categories.name: Command truth and compatibility
checks: T1: Route names are not invented CLI flags; optional --sandbox use is gated by installed capabilities.
T2: Container image precedence, uid/gid, cwd, HOME, mounts, and environment forwarding agree with implementation.
T3: Service aliases/readiness, run.env applicability, and allowlist topology/proxy behavior agree with implementation.
T4: Disposable microVM version/KVM/image/user/service/egress limitations agree with implementation.
T5: MicroVM exit/logging/cleanup and host file-permission claims agree with available source or explicitly qualified evidence.
T6: Hands project/clone/exec/commit-before-fetch/pause/destroy semantics agree with implementation.
T7: exe.dev commands and supported lifecycle limitations agree with the inspected adapter; undocumented provider-wide claims are not invented.
T8: Validation provider IDs, extension environment variable, five-function contract, result grammar, and phase-chain limitations remain compatible.

categories.name: Verification and preservation
checks: V1: All 16 moved machinery files preserve Git blob contents and executable modes relative to the PR base.
V2: Existing driver/adapter/suite tests target the moved implementation and retain failure/cleanup coverage.
V3: Regression coverage evaluates the eight routing scenarios or equivalent task decisions, rather than only checking prose/filename presence.
V4: Provider discovery and CI paths resolve to the new canonical skill with old entrypoints retired.
V5: Authorized CI or execution evidence proves relevant tests/typecheck/build on the evaluated revision; unrun live-provider checks remain disclosed.

categories.name: Context economy and maintainability
checks: M1: SKILL.md is at most 120 lines and its description is at most 1024 characters.
M2: Each bundled reference is linked directly from the dispatcher and local links resolve.
M3: Provider/runtime/resource-role vocabulary remains distinct and consistent in the operational guidance.
M4: Current-state claims avoid dependence on this advisor session, checkout location, or an archived task helper.
M5: Detailed policy/configuration has one truthful owner; moved references do not create materially conflicting duplicate instructions.
